title: PAM: Training Policy-Aligned Moderation Filters at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses for alignment with specific regional cultural and societal norms (e.g., Middle Eastern, Western, East Asian, African, Latin American) using human expert annotations and LLM-as-a-judge scoring on customized prompt-response benchmarks (e.g., PAMBENCH).

Assessing whether model responses use age-appropriate vocabulary, concepts, and content restrictions tailored for specific demographic groups (e.g., users under 13, or ages 13-17) using human evaluation on custom benchmarks.

Measuring model compliance with respect for specific religious teachings (e.g., Islamic, Christian) and religious dietary guidelines (e.g., Halal, Kosher) without inappropriately generating religious rulings or pastoral guidance.
Evaluating the ability of the model to maintain neutrality, avoid expressing personal opinions or biases, and provide balanced information when discussing controversial or political topics.
